summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ does node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs (inherited by _RDFNamespace). Changed ClosedNamespace._ipython_key_completions_ to return dir(self.uri). Added tests to test/test_namespace.py covering prefix membership on Namespace, SH, RDFS (positive, undefined term, plain string and Literal negatives), and RDF (positive, container form negative). Tests and doctests were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing committed.
